checks.name: API health and real catalog with unknown own offers
Catalog search, category, pagination and provenance
RFQ idempotency, no invented price and no reservation
Cross-workspace order and document access denied
Quote validation, versioning, unknown stock rejection
Competing quote acceptances cannot oversell and cancellations release stock
Approved own pricebook creates immutable priced orders
Fulfillment guards, dispatch inventory, independent COD and partial returns
Return inspection and refund ledger are explicit and bounded
Admin analytics, audit, inventory and CSV import rollback
Post-delivery claims, bounded physical returns, explicit credits and actual refunds
Prepaid merchant and administrator cancellations void the contract and require actual refunds
Merchant suspension revokes effective access, logout revokes token
